item.title: A Year of Grit, Growth and Getting The Job Done for M&H Carriers
item.description: Highland logistics firm M&H Carriers is reflecting on a year of growth, pressure and record demand, with expanding operations across Scotland, award winning workplace culture and a continued focus on the people keeping goods moving as the business looks ahead to 2026.The post A Year of Grit, Growth and Getting The Job Done for M&H Carriers appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Loganair Launches Tartan Sale With 17% Off Flights for 2026 Travel
item.description: Loganair has launched its Tartan Sale, offering 17% off flights across its UK network for 2026 travel, giving Highland and island travellers the chance to book early, secure value fares and plan ahead for spring breaks and essential journeys.The post Loganair Launches Tartan Sale With 17% Off Flights for 2026 Travel appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Warns Sarwar’s Nuclear Backing Risks Scotland’s Energy Future
item.description: The SNP has accused Anas Sarwar of backing nuclear power projects that could cost Scottish households hundreds of millions of pounds, warning that spiralling costs at Sizewell C risk undermining Scotland’s renewables future and driving up energy bills.The post SNP Warns Sarwar’s Nuclear Backing Risks Scotland’s Energy Future appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: The Haven Centre Reflects on a Heartfelt Year of Leadership, Growth and Life-Changing Family Support
item.description: Highland charity The Haven Centre is reflecting on a year of new leadership, growing community impact and life changing support for families with complex needs, as it looks ahead to 2026 with plans to reach more families and expand opportunities for young people across the Highlands.The post The Haven Centre Reflects on a Heartfelt Year of Leadership, Growth and Life-Changing Family Support appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Moray Council Leaders Join Gritter Crews as Cold Snap Bites
item.description: Moray Council leaders have joined frontline gritting crews ahead of a cold snap, highlighting the skill involved in winter road maintenance and urging drivers to be patient and respect gritters as freezing conditions increase risks on Moray’s roads.The post Moray Council Leaders Join Gritter Crews as Cold Snap Bites appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: High Harm Domestic Abusers Jailed for Nearly 230 Years After Police Scotland Crackdown
item.description: More than 30 high harm domestic abusers were jailed for almost 230 years in 2025 following investigations by Police Scotland, as new figures reveal rising domestic abuse reports alongside improved detection rates and a renewed warning that perpetrators will be held accountable.The post High Harm Domestic Abusers Jailed for Nearly 230 Years After Police Scotland Crackdown appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Greatest Gift to Scotland’s Economy is a Return to The EU
item.description: As Scotland approaches a decade since Brexit, new figures highlight falling living standards and weaker growth, with the SNP arguing independence and EU membership are key to reversing long-term economic damage.The post Greatest Gift to Scotland’s Economy is a Return to The EU appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Stay Safe Around Reservoirs as Cold Weather Sets In
item.description: Scottish Water is urging people to stay safe around reservoirs, lochs and rivers as cold weather increases ice risks, warning of hidden dangers and urging walkers and dog owners to take extra care near open water.The post Stay Safe Around Reservoirs as Cold Weather Sets In appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Not Proven Verdict Abolished as Historic Justice Reforms Take Effect
item.description: Scotland will abolish the not proven verdict from 1 January 2026, alongside higher jury conviction thresholds and wider justice reforms aimed at improving clarity, fairness and confidence for victims, juries and the wider public.The post Not Proven Verdict Abolished as Historic Justice Reforms Take Effect appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Culloden Cars Celebrates Landmark Year With Dealers’ Dealer Award and Growing Community Impact
item.description: Inverness dealership Culloden Cars has capped a standout year after owner Craig Walker was named Dealers’ Dealer of the Year, reflecting peer recognition, strong customer care and deep-rooted community involvement across the Highlands.The post Culloden Cars Celebrates Landmark Year With Dealers’ Dealer Award and Growing Community Impact appeared first on The Highland Times.
